family.description: Omp_AT is a family of Gram-negative Gamma-proteobacteria outer membrane autotransporter beta-barrel proteins. Secondary structure prediction indicates a beta-barrel domain of 12 beta-strands. with an N terminal helix running along the central barrel axis perpendicular to the 12 antiparallel strands that form the barrel. Autotransporter translocation units defined by a beta-barrel of 12 to 14 antiparallel strands with an N terminal helix perpendicular to the barrel [[cite:PUB00086595]].
family.name: Solitary outer membrane autotransporter beta-barrel domain
